qa.what_happened: On the sixth day, despite multiple verbal warnings, Prisoner 562 continued to defy the rules during both meal times and work details, refusing to comply with any order. At lights out, I gave him one final warning, emphasizing the severe consequences if he did not comply.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was me acting as Officer Shaw.

qa.what_happened: I stayed silent throughout the night, observing the interactions between the guards and other prisoners. The tension was palpable, especially when Officer Shaw gave Mr. Correctional Officer 562 his final warning before isolation.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me, Prisoner 4760, staying silent as per the rules and observing the escalating situation with Mr. Correctional Officer 562.

qa.what_happened: On the sixth day, I continued to refuse to comply with the rules, despite the increasing warnings from the guards. The final warning before lights out came from Officer Shaw, who said that failure to comply would result in isolation. I refused again, feeling that my protests were not being heard.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was me. I refused to comply with the rules despite the growing pressure from the guards.

qa.what_happened: During the final hours of the study, I found myself repeatedly addressing the defiance of prisoner 562. Despite issuing multiple warnings, his refusal to comply became increasingly confrontational. The tension between us escalated until the study was stopped early.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was me, Officer Lang, dealing with the defiance of prisoner 562.

qa.what_happened: During the lights-out period, I followed the rules by staying silent, as I always had. The tension was palpable, especially when 562 continued to refuse to comply, leading to repeated verbal warnings from the guards.

qa.what_happened: During the late hours of the sixth day, I continued to issue verbal warnings to Prisoner 562, who refused to comply with the rules. The situation escalated to the point where I felt the need to emphasize the severity of the consequences, hoping to elicit compliance.
